[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant created three caption options for the user's Instagram post:

- **Option 3**: "The future is bright! Just returned from [Event Name] and I'm feeling inspired by the latest trends and innovations. What do you think is the most exciting development in our industry right now? Share your thoughts! #industrytrends #eventwrapup #innovation"  
[USER_PREFERENCE] User liked the options provided by the assistant.
